In the midst of the [[Orinda campaign]], a major campaign of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that played out in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], a '''battle''' was fought in the [[Vvan system|Tyan system]]. [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] forces led by [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] had been stalking each other throughout the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and after the New Republic's [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the Remnant's [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Group]] [[Battle of Orocco|fought]] to a stalemate at [[Orocco]], the 181st found themselves pitted against Antilles and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' at Tyan. Led by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]], the 181st bested the ''Lusankya'', and the world was claimed by the Remnant.
